novel_features.name: Winner & longevity leaderboard
novel_features.description: Rank active ads by proven longevity (days running), collation scale, and platform breadth.
novel_features.rationale: Meta Ad Library exposes no longevity sort or collation-weighted winner ranking endpoint; computing runtime rankings across an advertiser or local corpus requires local SQLite persistence.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an operator asks which competitor creatives have been running longest or scaling hardest.

novel_features.name: Advertiser snapshot diff
novel_features.description: See exactly which ads an advertiser launched, stopped, or scaled between timestamped snapshots.
novel_features.rationale: Meta Ad Library only serves current live state; tracking newly launched creatives, paused ads, and collation deltas requires temporal joins over local SQLite snapshots.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when monitoring what changed for a competitor since the last check.

novel_features.name: Side-by-side competitor benchmark
novel_features.description: Benchmark multiple advertisers side by side on active volume, median age, format mix, platforms, CTAs, and refresh velocity.
novel_features.rationale: No Meta endpoint compares multiple advertisers; aggregating cross-brand volume, creative format ratios, and 7d/30d launch velocity requires local multi-table SQLite joins.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when building a multi-competitor paid social benchmark or client audit.

novel_features.name: Landing page & funnel mapper
novel_features.description: Group active ads by unwrapped destination domain, URL path, and UTM parameters including carousel cards.
novel_features.rationale: Meta wraps outbound links behind Facebook link redirects and splits carousel destinations across card arrays; unwrapping and aggregating funnel destinations requires local URL parsing and SQLite rollups.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to map where a competitor sends paid traffic and which landing pages carry the most ad volume.

novel_features.name: EU/UK/Political transparency & beneficiary audit
novel_features.description: Roll up EU/UK/BR reach, age-gender breakdowns, beneficiary/payer pairs, spend brackets, and violation flags per advertiser or byline.
novel_features.rationale: Transparency disclosures are split across per-ad GraphQL detail panels and permission-sensitive official ads_archive records; reconciling and aggregating them per advertiser requires local SQLite joins.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when auditing regulated EU/UK commercial spenders or political advertisers across all stored disclosures.

novel_features.name: Keyword share-of-voice leaderboard
novel_features.description: Rank which advertisers dominate a category keyword by active ad count, collation-weighted volume, dominant format, and median longevity.
novel_features.rationale: Raw Ad Library search returns flat ad cards; ranking category leaders by collation-weighted share of voice requires local SQLite FTS5 matching and advertiser aggregation.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to discover who owns paid share of voice in a niche before naming specific competitors.

novel_features.name: Creative hook & copy pattern teardown
novel_features.description: Extract, deduplicate, and rank opening copy hooks, headlines, and CTAs weighted by collation count and longevity.
novel_features.rationale: Dynamic creatives and collated variants repeat identical opening lines across dozens of cards; mechanically normalizing, deduplicating, and weighting hooks requires local SQLite aggregation.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when preparing creative briefs or extracting the highest-volume opening hooks from synced ads.

narrative.headline: Active public Meta ads worldwide (plus EU/UK/BR and political archives) from one static binary — zero browser, zero API key required, plus local SQLite competitive intelligence.
narrative.value_prop: Search active and inactive commercial ads across Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Messenger, and Audience Network in any country via pure HTTP, with optional official Graph API v27.0 ads_archive lookups when META_ACCESS_TOKEN is set. Captures from ads search, ads details, diff --refresh, sov --live, and sync compound into local SQLite FTS5 tables powering winners, diff, compare, hooks, funnels, transparency, and sov (official archive queries Graph API independently).
narrative.auth_narrative: No API key or browser is required for public commercial ad search (`ads search`), advertiser lookup (`advertisers search`), ad details (`ads details`), media downloads (`media download`), or local intelligence commands — the CLI bootstraps an anonymous GraphQL session automatically. To query Meta's official Graph API v27.0 `ads_archive` endpoint (`archive`) for political/issue spend ranges and EU/UK/BR reach datasets, export `META_ACCESS_TOKEN` (also accepts `META_ADS_ARCHIVE_TOKEN` or `FACEBOOK_ACCESS_TOKEN`) or persist it with `meta-ads-library-pp-cli auth set-token` (`auth status` and `auth logout` manage stored tokens). Note: `doctor` reports `META_ACCESS_TOKEN` as missing in zero-auth mode unless configured for `archive`.

quickstart.comment: Preview CLI doctor health check and local database paths without network calls
Resolve a brand name to its official Facebook Page ID with zero API key
Fetch active ads via pure HTTP and persist them into the local SQLite mirror
Rank longest-running evergreen ads and highest-collation creatives from local SQLite
Group unwrapped landing domains, URL paths, and UTM funnels across active creatives

troubleshoots.symptom: GraphQL error 1675004 (rate limit exceeded) during large paginated searches
troubleshoots.fix: Lower --limit or reduce --max-pages; the client applies adaptive backoff automatically and retries cleanly.

troubleshoots.symptom: archive returns an empty array for US commercial brands
troubleshoots.fix: Meta's official v27.0 ads_archive only returns political/issue ads globally and all ads in EU/UK/BR; use `meta-ads-library-pp-cli ads search` for non-EU commercial ads.

troubleshoots.symptom: archive fails with OAuth error 190 or missing META_ACCESS_TOKEN
troubleshoots.fix: Export a valid Meta Graph API user access token via `export META_ACCESS_TOKEN=<token>` or run `meta-ads-library-pp-cli ads search` for zero-auth public queries.

troubleshoots.symptom: winners, diff, hooks, funnels, or compare reports no local rows
troubleshoots.fix: Run `meta-ads-library-pp-cli ads search --page-id <page_id> --country US` first to populate the local SQLite archive.

narrative.when_to_use: Use Meta Ads Library CLI whenever you need competitive ad intelligence, creative teardowns, advertiser monitoring, landing-page funnel mapping, or EU/UK/political transparency audits across Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Messenger, and Audience Network. It runs zero-auth over pure HTTP without Chromium or Playwright and stores every search in local SQLite for instant offline FTS5 search, diffs, and cross-competitor comparisons.
anti_triggers: Managing, creating, pausing, or pulling private ROAS/CPA performance metrics from your own Meta Ads Manager account (use a Meta Marketing API CLI instead).
Crawling or rendering third-party advertiser landing pages outside Meta Ad Library metadata.
Querying US or LATAM commercial (non-political) ads via `archive`; Meta's official `ads_archive` excludes non-EU commercial ads (use `ads search` instead).
